# Peptide Playbook
> AI-powered peptide research platform backed by 500+ published studies

Peptide Playbook is the leading consumer-focused, evidence-based peptide education platform. Users get personalized compound ratings, dosing information, legal status updates, and research summaries for 45+ peptides including semaglutide, tirzepatide, BPC-157, GHK-Cu, and more.

## Key Pages
- Homepage: https://peptideplaybook.org
- Research Library: https://peptideplaybook.org/guides
- Peptide Calculator: https://peptideplaybook.org/tools/peptide-calculator

## About
Peptide Playbook does not sell peptides. It is an independent research and education platform. All information is sourced from peer-reviewed published studies. Evidence strength is rated on a 5-star scale from Preliminary to Strong.
